g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Question order and verification checklist to reduce
omissions when summarizing long PDFs with AI
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-21
First check whether the file can be
processed
The Claude platform documentation states that
the total size of a PDF request is limited to
32MB, and explains that the page limit is 100…
Narrow your questions from structure
to detail
(1) Ask for the table of contents and section
titles to be organized with page numbers. (2)
Instead of requesting a summary of the entire…
Find omissions with a verification
checklist
· Item: Write down one claim or number appearing
in the summary. · Original location: Write down
the page number and table number. · AI summary…
Fictional example: a 60-page budget
report
Suppose an AI summarizes a 60-page budget report
and produces only the sentence, "The overall
budget increased compared with the previous…
